youtube.title: Where is the deepest lake in the world? Deeper than the Great Lakes put together 🌊
youtube.description:
The Great Lakes, Africa's rift or the third one? One lake goes down more than a mile and a half and holds about a fifth of all the unfrozen fresh water on Earth — more than all five Great Lakes combined. Hundreds of rivers flow in. Only one flows out.
Which did you pick?
